svg.aria-label: Every surface. Every market. Every release. An LED sign in KaDeep Studio's dots, each word blinking in turn: blue, orange, then green. Web, mobile and desktop: the agent walks the live product in the browser, on phones and in desktop apps. Every language you sell, checked on the live screen. Release-ready, on demand: every build gets the same walk, with the evidence behind the verdict.
